main_text.p: מצוּרים Retia. Vide praterea in מָצָד.
צִיָּה Pihel Præcipere, Mandare: Pyhal צִוָּה Præcipi, Juberi.
מִצּוּלָה, צוּלָה צוֹל f. Profundum, Profunditas: plur. מִצוּלֹת & מְצוּלוֹת.
צוּם Jejunare, צוֹם m. Jejunium: plural. צוֹמוֹת.
צוּף Effluere, Exundare, Supernatare. Hiphil הֵצִיף Inundare, Fluere, vel Natare fecit.
צוּף m. Favus, à Fluendo & stillando dictus: plur. צּוּפִים.
צוֹק Arctari, Coarctari, Arcte cohœrere. Hiphil הֵצִיק Arctavit, Coarctavit, Anxit, Pressit, Angustavit. Hophal הוּצַק Angustari.
מָצוֹק m. מְצוּקָה f. Angustia, Pressura.
צוּר Obsidere, Arctare, Inimicari, Hostiliter agere.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words are transcribed as far as legible; the page is slightly damaged at the edges and some vowel points are uncertain.
